_comment: dB of fight sounds that no action names (see resources/sfx/README.md). A hit sounds at its action's db; these are for the rest.

footstep_db._comment: How loud a step is on each floor, by the floor's `footsteps` material (game/tiles, defaults to the tile name without floor_). A floor not listed uses default. Over a whisper (30) on hard floors, so whispering is quieter than walking.
